source: Read-only survey of the energy-shaping-ML project (José's), which fixes LocoHub data at prepare time and leaves LocoHub parquets unchanged. Nothing was run; files were read by name and text only. Claims below are that project's, not independently verified here.

findings.item: Treadmill plate registration for foot-frame CoP
findings.detail: There is no plate-to-lab transform. The plate offset per recording is the leave-subject-out median of other subjects' own-moment offsets in the same condition, using donors with a lever-residual IQR of 20 mm or less. Error against the recording's own offset: median 4-11 mm by condition, p95 34 mm. Moments behave as if taken about the Plug-in Gait ankle centre (median 16 mm behind the malleolar midpoint along the foot). Belt height comes from the push-off rotation centre (0-4 cm above the Vicon origin). Belt frame tilts with incline; decline faces the other way. 29 tests; used in 5-fold training.

findings.item: Pelvis sign doubled into shank/foot; AB01 i5 is a copy of i10
findings.detail: Matches LocoHub findings; LocoHub already rebuilds thigh/shank after the sign step and leaves AB01 i5 out.

findings.item: Per-foot force plate assignment and force sidecar
findings.detail: Each plate contact goes to the foot whose heel-toe midpoint is nearest the plate CoP, with an ambiguous two-feet zone and an events fallback. Forces and CoP are summed over the foot's plates. Signs: vertical = sum vy, anterior = -sum vz, lateral = sum vx, over weight_kg*9.81. Lateral CoP is in the foot-heading frame; rows beyond 0.10 m are NaN. A per-recording counts CSV is included. 11 tests; used in training.

findings.item: Ankle joint centre from the authors' scaled model
findings.detail: Joint centre from tibia_<side>_offset in the scaled .osim: median 8.6 mm (0.9-17.8) anterior of the lateral malleolus marker. Ankle height above the sole is 4.5-5.7 cm per subject. There is no medial marker, even in the static trial.

3,375 rows with |angle| beyond 1.5/2.5 rad, mostly whole segments of AB24 ramp_1 (5.8-7.8 rad, likely wraps) and AB07 levelground cw slow seg01. Proposed, not applied there. Also a plate-dropout rule: vGRF == 0 with |moment| > 0.3 Nm/kg.

findings.item: Ankle and CoP geometry from the Scaled1 models
findings.detail: Talus origin is 0.04877 m anterior of the calcn origin along calcn x. It lies a median 35.7 mm below the ankle-marker midpoint along the tibia (range 24.3-47.7) and 0.7 mm behind it. The knee-marker axis is 1.7 deg off tibia y. AB01 uses the -Scaled1_original model.

Heel-strike detection per subject and task; stairs and non-cyclic tasks were excluded there. No validation against the authors' windows. GT23 AB03 was dropped in that project; no reason was found in its files.

cautions: The ESML UM21 ankle point (malleolar midpoint + 35.7 mm down the shank) borrows a GT23 model constant; LocoHub should not copy that across datasets without its own check.
CoP columns in the current LocoHub parquets are not comparable across datasets (UM21 displacement from first loaded sample, GT21 lab offset from lateral malleolus, GT23 calcn frame).
